nonex: It does NOT mean to cook food.
It does NOT mean to buy food at a store.
vocab.example: The raccoons forage in the forest for nuts and berries every evening.
vocab.starter: If I had to forage for food, I would look for _______ ...
vocab.why: Forage is useful for writing about how animals find their food in nature!

sentences.orig: the girl writed a letter and sended it to her grandma

corr.e: The first word of a sentence must be capitalized.
Wrote is the correct past tense of write. It is an irregular verb.
Sent is the correct past tense of send. It is an irregular verb.
Letter is correct. Grandma should stay as is too.
A telling sentence must end with a period.

sentences.fixed: The girl wrote a letter and sent it to her grandma.

vocab.def: To take care of or look after something or someone.
vocab.simple: Tend means to take care of something, like a farmer taking care of animals or plants!
nonex: It does NOT mean to break.
It does NOT mean to throw away.
vocab.example: The kind farmer wakes up early to tend the chickens and cows every morning.
vocab.starter: I like to tend _______ because ...
vocab.why: Tend is a caring word that shows how we look after living things around us!

vocab.def: To go and get something and bring it back.

nonex: It does NOT mean to throw.

vocab.def: To move at a speed between walking and running, with short bouncy steps.
vocab.simple: Trot means to go faster than a walk but slower than a run, like a horse going at a steady pace!
nonex: It does NOT mean to run at full speed.
It does NOT mean to sit down.
vocab.example: The pony will trot around the ring while the children watch and clap.
vocab.starter: I like to trot when _______ ...
vocab.why: Trot is a great word to describe a pace that is faster than walking but not quite running!
